title: Visitor from the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: The observer departed, leaving behind these words: 'The key to the fourth page is being sought by both the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets and the Eye of Heavenly Dao' — the words echoed through the silent secret passage, and Chen Ji's fingers tightened abruptly around the fragment.

text.content: At the entrance of the secret passage, Chen Nian's handwriting appeared especially glaring under the pale blue spirit stone light. Those five characters — 'Brother, I'm waiting for you on the fourth page' — each stroke carried Chen Nian's unique sharpness, carved three inches deep into the stone wall, far from something hastily left behind. Where was she? What had she experienced? These questions gnawed at his heart like ten thousand ants, yet Chen Ji forced them down. He slowly closed his eyes, the Tianji Record fragment in his palm warming slightly, his foresight ability stirring restlessly. After a moment, he opened his eyes, and his gaze had become a cold abyss. The aura from the depths of the ruins told him this place was not as quiet as it appeared — something was watching him.

Chen Ji tucked the fragment into his sleeve and moved silently deeper into the secret passage. The air carried an indescribable scent — not decay, not spiritual energy, but an aura that seemed to have existed since time immemorial, transcending this world. His back grew slightly cold. He had only felt this sensation before when facing the projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. But this time, it was more intense, more... condescending. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke in his mind: 'Be careful, a guest is coming.'

The end of the secret passage opened into a wide stone chamber, its four walls covered with indecipherable runes. The moment Chen Ji stepped into the chamber, those runes suddenly illuminated, converging into a humanoid silhouette of light. The silhouette gradually solidified, and a middle-aged man in plain white robes appeared before him. This person's features were blurred, as if veiled by a thin mist, only those eyes clearly visible — deep as an abyss, seeming to pierce through all illusion in the world. 'Chen Ji, servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect,' the visitor's voice was calm as water yet carried undeniable authority, 'you are more cautious than I anticipated.'

The white-robed figure slightly tilted his head, those deep eyes seeming to pierce through Chen Ji's disguise, reaching the deepest parts of his heart. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his fingers secretly gripped the fragment in his sleeve, ready at any moment to foresee dangers within the next three hours. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul warnedwhisperedly in his consciousness: 'This person's aura... I've never seen anything like it. He exists outside the laws of Heavenly Dao!' Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face still wore the terror befitting a timid disciple, stepping back half a pace at the perfect moment, his performance of fear and wariness flawless.

dialogue.content: No need to be nervous, I mean no harm. I come from the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets — a dimension you have never touched. The Eye of Heavenly Dao thinks it is the master of this realm, but it too is merely a piece on our chessboard. And you, Chen Ji, are the most interesting piece I've ever seen.

choice.prompt: Facing this mysterious figure who claims to be from the 'Bureau of Heavenly Secrets,' Chen Ji needs to judge the visitor's intentions.

choices.description: Present himself as a worthless disciple to appear weak, extract more information about the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets, while secretly observing the other party's weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: May expose his ignorance about the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence and judge the other party's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: Since the other party can see through his disguise, testing may have limited effect

text.content: Chen Ji performed his fear flawlessly, his lips trembling slightly: 'Th-the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets? The junior is ignorant and has never heard... Why would an elder seek someone as insignificant as me?' He deliberately emphasized the words 'insignificant person,' his eyes showing appropriate confusion and fear. The white-robed figure seemed amused by his acting, the corner of his mouth lifting slightly: 'Interesting, you can still hide your abilities under my gaze. You are far more interesting than those self-righteous sect prodigies.'

choices.description: Without being servile or overbearing, engage the other party as an equal, displaying composure unbecoming of his worthless persona, and observe the other party's reactions.
choices.visible_cost: May break his worthless persona and alert the other party
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain core information and determine if it's a trap
choices.risk_hint: Since the other party appeared voluntarily, they must have ulterior motives; being overly cooperative may lead into a trap

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly收敛 his fearful expression, replacing it with an unnatural calm. He stared directly into those abyssal eyes and said calmly: 'Since the elder can appear here silently, surely you have investigated me thoroughly. Rather than beating around the bush, why not speak directly about your intentions?' A flicker of appreciation crossed the white-robed figure's eyes: 'Good, straightforward. Allow me to introduce myself — I am an observer from the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets, specializing in observing variables with 'independent will' like you. The Eye of Heavenly Dao thinks it's the chess player, but it doesn't know it too is a piece. And you are the most restless piece on its chessboard.'

dialogue.content: The Bureau of Heavenly Secrets exists beyond the laws of Heavenly Dao, independent of cause and effect and the cycle of rebirth. We observe, record, occasionally intervene — but never directly interfere. Until... you appeared. A prophet chosen by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, yet displaying 'independent will' it never anticipated. This is a loophole, a variable, and also... an opportunity.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, and a great storm surged in his heart. The Bureau of Heavenly Secrets? An existence beyond the Eye of Heavenly Dao? This information completely overturned his understanding of this realm. But his expression remained still as an ancient well, even showing a faint smile: 'The elder's meaning is... you wish to recruit me?' The white-robed figure nodded: 'You could put it that way. The Eye of Heavenly Dao sees you as a piece, wanting to squeeze every drop of your Heavenly Fate Value. The Bureau of Heavenly Secrets can give you true freedom — if you are willing to cooperate.'

choice.prompt: Faced with the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets' recruitment offer, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Pretend to consider cooperation while actually extracting more intelligence about the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets and the Eye of Heavenly Dao, preparing for possible future confrontation.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as a person of the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets, losing the trust of certain factions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain fatal weakness information about the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Since the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets can observe everything, disguise may be exposed

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, seemingly weighing the pros and cons. After a long while, he raised his head, his eyes carrying a 'persuaded' compromise: 'The junior is willing to listen to the elder's counsel. However... the junior is not free, the Eye of Heavenly Dao monitors at all times. How can the junior trust the elder's words?' The white-robed figure seemed satisfied with his attitude: 'Good, you are more sensible than I anticipated. As for trust —' He took out a crystal-clear jade talisman from his sleeve, 'this can conceal your Tianji Record's aura for one hour. Enough time for you to think.'

choices.description: Make his stance clear — accepting recruitment from no faction, even an existence beyond Heavenly Dao. Display Chen Ji's independent will and ambition.
choices.visible_cost: May offend the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets and lose a potential ally
choices.visible_reward: Display independent will before the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets, accumulating leverage for future negotiations
choices.risk_hint: The consequences of provoking a force beyond Heavenly Dao are hard to foresee

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a pride that seemed to look down upon the world: 'The elder's kindness is appreciated. But this Chen Ji refuses to be anyone's piece — neither the Eye of Heavenly Dao nor the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets.' The white-robed figure's eyes narrowed slightly: 'Are you certain? This is the only chance I offer you.' Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, the fragment in his palm faintly glowing: 'Chance? My path, Chen Ji walks it myself. I need no one's charity.' Silence fell over the stone chamber. The white-robed figure stared at him for a long while before suddenly laughing aloud: 'Good! Good that you 'walk your own path'! I was not wrong about you.'

choices.description: Don't take a clear stance, use interest exchange as the entry point, test what price the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets is willing to pay, while seeking clues about his sister Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the people and things he cares about most
choices.visible_reward: Obtain new clues and possible assistance in finding Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Exposing weaknesses may invite greater danger

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately; instead, he slightly tilted his head: 'The elder said the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets can give me true freedom, so — I want to know my sister Chen Nian's whereabouts.' A flash of understanding crossed the white-robed figure's eyes: 'You do care about her.' Chen Ji's heart tightened; the other party's intelligence was deeper than he imagined: 'Since the elder knows about Chen Nian, you should know she is my only relative.' The white-robed figure pondered: 'Chen Nian... she was taken by the Holy Sect, called the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' and indeed occupies an important position in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's plans. But her whereabouts —' He paused, 'the answer lies in the fourth page. Both the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets and the Eye of Heavenly Dao are seeking that key.'

dialogue.content: Whatever choice you make, there is one thing you must know — once the fourth page is opened, it will trigger a direct conflict between the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets. At that time, no matter which side you stand with, you will face unprecedented crisis. Of course, this is also the only chance to escape the chess game and become a true chess player.

text.content: The white-robed figure's form began to fade, and the runes on the stone walls gradually dimmed. Before completely disappearing, his voice echoed through the chamber: 'Chen Ji, consider my words carefully. The Bureau of Heavenly Secrets welcomes your joining anytime.' He paused, and his final words rang like thunder: 'By the way, the key to the fourth page — the Eye of Heavenly Dao is also seeking it. And it has already sent someone.' The words fell, and the chamber returned to silence. Chen Ji stood alone, his brow furrowed. The Bureau of Heavenly Secrets' involvement, the key to the fourth page, Chen Nian's whereabouts — all the clues intertwined, forming a giant web whose full picture he had yet to see.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed softly in his consciousness: 'The Bureau of Heavenly Secrets... I should have thought of this. The cause and effect, the cycle of rebirth in this realm, indeed do not have only the Eye of Heavenly Dao as a chess player.' Chen Ji asked in his heart: 'Does Master know about the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets?' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: 'I know some, but they are all ancient legends. It is said they exist outside of cause and effect, unbound by any law.' His tone turned grave, 'If the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets has truly taken interest in you, it means you have grown strong enough to threaten the Eye of Heavenly Dao — this is both good and bad.'

dialogue.content: The observer departed, leaving behind these words: 'The key to the fourth page is being sought by both the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets and the Eye of Heavenly Dao' — the words echoed through the silent secret passage, and Chen Ji's fingers tightened abruptly around the fragment.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, temporarily suppressing his turbulent thoughts. Regardless of whether the Bureau of Heavenly Secrets is friend or foe, the most urgent matter at hand is — someone is coming. He raised his head toward the entrance of the secret passage, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's people, or another faction? In any case, the clues about Chen Nian lie ahead. Even if a dragon's pool and tiger's den awaited, he would charge through. He straightened his robes, resumed the timidity befitting a worthless disciple, and walked deeper into the secret passage. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: 'Be careful, the aura of the fourth page is growing stronger... Your sister seems to be waiting for you there.' Chen Ji's steps faltered momentarily, then he took the next step with even greater determination.
